2027-01-09.title: First Saturday of Denha
2027-01-09.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; mapped from the official calendar, verify locally)
readings: The one whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world
2027-01-09.verse: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.
theo: In the season of Denha the Church keeps asking: who is this Jesus revealed at the Jordan? In today's Gospel the question becomes dangerous. In the Temple the crowd picks up stones, and Jesus asks: “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these are you going to stone me?” They answer that it is for blasphemy, “because you, though only a human being, are making yourself God.” Jesus does not withdraw his claim. He is “the one whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world”, and he points to his works: “believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.” The voice at the Jordan said the same: this is my Son.

St Paul faces the same mystery from another side. Gentiles who were not seeking righteousness have received it, “that is, righteousness through faith”, while many in Israel, seeking it by works, “have stumbled over the stumbling stone”. Christ is that stone: for some a rock to trip over, for others a sure foundation, for “whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.” The same Jesus who is the light of Denha can become a stone we trip over, if we want to save ourselves on our own terms. Faith receives him as a gift.
outline: Ask: what makes it hard for people today to believe that Jesus is God?
A gift received, not a wage earned.
Christ, a rock to trip over or to build on.
The Father in the Son, the Son in the Father.
“The Father is in me and I am in the Father.”
live: Thank God today for one gift you did nothing to deserve.
Write down one work of God you have seen in your life this past year.
2027-01-09.prayer: Lord Jesus, sanctified and sent into the world by the Father, you are in the Father and the Father is in you. Let me not stumble over you through pride, but build my life on you by faith, and let your works lead me to adore you as my Lord and my God. Amen.
altar: At every Holy Qurbana we profess that Jesus is God from God, Light from Light, one in being with the Father. Here the stone rejected by the builders becomes the cornerstone of our life.

quick: Righteousness comes through faith, not as a wage for our works.
Christ is a stone of stumbling for the proud and a foundation for believers.
Jesus' works show that the Father is in him and he is in the Father.
2027-01-09.action: Thank God for one gift you did nothing to deserve.
2027-01-09.question: Do I build on Christ, or do I stumble over him?

family.explain: Some people did not believe that Jesus was God's Son. Jesus said: look at what I do! My good works show that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.
family.intention: We pray for people who find it hard to believe in Jesus.
family.ask: Ask: “What good things has Jesus done for our family?”

illus: A young engineer from Kozhikode working in Pune stopped going to church in college; he said he could not believe that a man could be God. A Hindu colleague invited him to help at a home run by sisters for abandoned elderly people. He went for his colleague's sake and kept going for two years. He said later: I came back to the Creed through the works, just as Jesus says in John 10.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, the Father is in you and you are in the Father. Help us to believe your works and to build our lives on you. Amen.
share: Gentiles attained righteousness through faith (Romans 9:30). Do I try to earn God's love?
Whoever believes in him will not be put to shame (Romans 9:33). Where am I afraid of being put to shame?
Believe the works (John 10:38). What works of God have I seen?
pm.resp: Lord, we believe; help our unbelief.
interc: For the Church, that her works may show the Father's love.
For those who find it hard to believe that Jesus is God.
For our Jewish brothers and sisters, the people of the first covenant.
For those who try to save themselves by their own strength.
For our group, that our faith may rest on Christ the cornerstone.
pm.close: Father, you sanctified your Son and sent him into the world. Give us faith to receive him, and let our lives rest on him who is in you, as you are in him. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, in the season of Denha we keep asking: who is this Jesus revealed at the Jordan? In today's Gospel some in the Temple pick up stones to throw at him. Jesus asks: I have shown you many good works from the Father; for which of these are you going to stone me? (John 10:32).

They answer: not for a good work, but because you, though only a human being, are making yourself God (John 10:33). They understood his claim correctly; they refused to believe it. Jesus does not soften it. He is the one whom the Father has sanctified and sent into the world. Believe the works, he says, so that you may know that the Father is in me and I am in the Father (John 10:36–38).

St Paul looks at the same mystery. Gentiles who were not searching for righteousness received it through faith, while many who tried to earn it by works stumbled over the stumbling stone (Romans 9:30–32). Christ can be a stone we trip over, if we want to save ourselves by our own strength. Or he can be our foundation, for whoever believes in him will not be put to shame (Romans 9:33).
At the Jordan the Father said: this is my Son. Let us receive him by faith, look at his works in our lives and in the Church, and build everything on him. Amen.
kids: Children, some people did not believe that Jesus was God's Son. Jesus said: look at the good things I do! Let us thank Jesus for the good things he does for us, and do good things in his name.

intro: Theme: “The Father is in me and I am in the Father.”
Faith receives the Son whom the Father sent.

q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.
What then are we to say? Gentiles, who did not strive for righteousness, have attained it, that is, righteousness through faith;
points.apply: Thank God each night this week for one undeserved gift.

q: therefore thus says the Lord GOD, See, I am laying in Zion a foundation stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation: “One who trusts will not panic.”
as it is written, “See, I am laying in Zion a stone that will make people stumble, a rock that will make them fall, and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame.”
points.apply: Bring one area of pride to Christ in confession.

q: I say, “You are gods, children of the Most High, all of you;
But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.
points.apply: Write down one work of God you have seen this year and thank him for it.

concl: The Son revealed at the Jordan is one with the Father.
Faith builds on him; pride stumbles over him.
2027-01-09.resolve: Make an act of faith in Jesus, true God and true man, each morning this week.
